email_subject: Application - Product Designer: UX/UI, Mobile-First & Remote
email_body:
Dear PetsAgile team,

I'm applying for the Product Designer role. My background sits where design, code and content meet: I've designed and built websites in WordPress/Elementor, hand-coded a landing page with a WebGL hero and accessible markup, and shipped an Android app live on Google Play. That mix means I can move from a user flow to a working prototype without losing the details that make an interface feel right.

At Knowledge Experts I helped build SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, designing site structures for thousands of staff. As a freelancer I run my own site and built mirook.com end to end, from layout to structured data. I work daily with LLMs and Python to test ideas quickly, and I care about measurable usability rather than decoration.

I'd welcome the chance to bring that hands-on, human-centered approach to your pet technology products.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear PetsAgile team,

I'm writing to apply for the Product Designer role. Your focus on human-centered design, cross-functional collaboration and design systems that scale is exactly the kind of work I want to do more of, and my background gives me an unusual angle on it: I design, build and test interfaces myself, so I understand both the user's experience and the engineering constraints behind it.

At Knowledge Experts I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (an application gallery for 12,000 staff). That meant thinking about structure, navigation and consistency for very large user groups, not just individual screens. As a freelancer I designed and built baverok.com myself, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, accessible markup and a free site-check enquiry flow. I also built mirook.com end to end, from layout to structured data, and I have an Android app live on Google Play, which taught me how much mobile-first thinking matters in practice.

I work daily with LLMs and Python to prototype and test ideas quickly, and I use analytics to check whether a change actually improved usability. I'm comfortable working remotely and asynchronously, and I like collaborating closely with product, engineering and marketing because the best interface decisions usually come from those conversations.

What draws me to PetsAgile is the chance to apply that hands-on, measurable approach to pet technology products, where warmth and clarity matter as much as function. I'd be glad to talk about how I can contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
